evidence.title: Triage and human review
evidence.text: Review Critical records first, then Watch records. Treat Unknown as a data-action queue, not as safety. A planner must verify local stock and shipment information before approving an action.

evidence.title: Usable stock and FEFO
evidence.text: Only released, non-expired batches count as usable. Project consumption first-expiry-first-out and count only confirmed inbound arrivals. Quarantine and planned shipments require separate review.

evidence.title: Budget-aware action planning
evidence.text: Compare feasible actions under an explicit ceiling, keep unfunded needs visible, and record human approval. The demo uses adaptive greedy cost-effectiveness ranking and does not claim global optimality or clinical priority.

evidence.title: Redistribution safeguards
evidence.text: Transfer only the exact product on an explicit feasible route. Preserve donor buffer, check remaining shelf life after arrival, and require cold-chain capability for cold-chain products. Local authorization is mandatory.

evidence.title: Data quality and provenance
evidence.text: Track reporting freshness, consumption-history completeness, dataset version, and checksums. Distinguish missing from zero. Do not use real personal or government data in this demo workspace.

evidence.title: AI and automation boundary
evidence.text: This release has no connected LLM. Retrieval answers cite demo evidence and computed facts. Deterministic tools own arithmetic and constraints; no model may autonomously approve expenditure or create clinical instructions.
